description: Image Description: The image depicts a sandy beach with multiple surfboards lined up in a row on the shore. The surfboards are placed parallel to each other, with some featuring green accents and others appearing plain white. In the background, there is a view of the ocean with gentle waves approaching the shore. The sky is overcast, contributing to a calm and muted atmosphere. There are no people present in the scene, and the focus is on the surfboards and the natural beach environment.
